description: Source code for managing Chrome's trust store, including creation, parsing, and retrieval of trust anchors and certificates.

classes.name: ChromeRootStoreData
classes.description: Represents the Chrome root store data, including trust anchors and version.

classes.name: TrustStoreChrome
classes.description: Manages Chrome's trust store, including trust anchors, trust evaluation, and issuer retrieval.

methods.name: CreateChromeRootStoreData
methods.description: Creates a ChromeRootStoreData object from a proto, parsing trust anchors.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome::TrustStoreChrome
methods.description: Constructs TrustStoreChrome with default or specified trust anchors and version.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome::SyncGetIssuersOf
methods.description: Retrieves issuer certificates for a given certificate.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome::GetTrust
methods.description: Returns trust information for a given certificate.

methods.name: TrustStoreChrome::Contains
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is in the trust store.

methods.name: CreateTrustStoreForTesting
methods.description: Creates a TrustStoreChrome instance for testing purposes.

methods.name: CompiledChromeRootStoreVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of the compiled Chrome root store.

methods.name: CompiledChromeRootStoreAnchors
methods.description: Returns a list of parsed certificates representing the Chrome root store anchors.
